title: PARIKSHA: Large-Scale Investigation of Human-LLM Evaluator Agreement on Multilingual and Multi-Cultural Data

bias_targets.methodology: Randomly duplicating 10% of pairwise model comparisons with the order of the options flipped to calculate the consistency of verdicts by both human and LLM evaluators.
Analyzing the win fraction of longer responses over shorter responses against the difference in text length to determine if evaluators systematically favor longer outputs.
Comparing the Elo leaderboard rankings generated by a GPT-4 evaluator against human evaluators to measure the average rank increase of GPT-4's own outputs (favoring its own generations).
